title: Oberwart sweep BBC Nord to clinch BSL title
description: Oberwart - BBC Nord 75-67 It was a great evening for American forward Robert Allen (206-2000, college: N.Texas, agency: Elevate Sports Alliance) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 8 rebounds. His fellow American import forward Ziggy Reid (198-2000, college: YSU, agency: Inception Sports) helped adding 17 points and 9 rebounds. The best for the losing side was British power forward Peter Turay (203-1999, college: CMU) with 16 points and 9 rebounds and American point guard Rayshawn Mart (190-1998, college: Xavier, LA) scored 17 points and 6 rebounds. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
